enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove pajamas. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Put on work clothes. Comb hair. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Take frying pan. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Turn off stove. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag and reviewing the day's patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open closet. Take out work bag. Open work bag. Place stethoscope, notebook, and pen into bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Review patient schedule. Close calendar app. Lock phone. Place phone into pocket. Pick up laptop. Place laptop into bag. Zip bag. Turn off desk lamp. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off at hospital stop. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review patient notes. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record temperature. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Update patient chart. Walk to next patient. Attend team meeting. Enter data into computer. Respond to call light. Assist with procedure. Take lunch break. End shift. Change out of scrubs. Walk to exit.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off at home stop. Walk to house. Unlock front door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook meat and vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Wash dishes. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Dry hair with towel. Apply lotion. Put on clean clothes. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Use phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check personal messages and unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at computer desk. Turn on computer. Open web browser. Check email. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Close social media. Close messaging app. Close browser. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Change into pajamas. Turn down bed covers. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Place phone on charger. Plug charger into outlet. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.
